text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

words.gloss_range: singular imperative introducing quoted prophetic speech and launching a plural-address evidentiary challenge
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speaking, and commanding speech; locally a clipped imperative of transmitted address

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: plural interrogative challenge meaning consider, judge, or reckon with the case rather than merely see

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) opens by making the whole argument commanded speech. The singular command addresses the Messenger, while the embedded challenge turns toward a plural audience, so authorization and accusation are grammatically separated. Its clipped form gives the ayah a hard oral launch into {{ar:أَرَأَيْتُمْ}} ({{tr:araʾaytum}}), and the repeated speech frame keeps this as a continued disputation rather than an isolated saying.

topics.headline: singular command authorizes plural challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge is not narrator exposition but commanded prophetic speech aimed through the Messenger at a plural audience.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes words 2-28 the quoted complement of the imperative, and the QAC row marks a second-person masculine singular command.

topics.headline: compact command opens a nested examination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short command as a hard launch into the longer perception challenge that follows.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the clipped imperative immediately before the audience-facing challenge formula.

topics.headline: repeated command continues the disputation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as a second-stage argument continuing the previous revelation-and-warning frame, while the local word still functions simply as the opening command.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the repeated speech command, but they are preserved as discourse continuity rather than a new syntactic role for the imperative.

topics.headline: clipped sound sharpens the turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the abrupt command as an oral turn before the reasoning begins.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and reinforces the command-to-examination movement without changing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: plural interrogative challenge meaning consider, judge, or reckon with the case rather than merely see
words.root_gloss_range: vision, perception, opinion, and judgment; locally the seeing root is grammaticalized as an evaluative challenge
words.prose: {{ar:أَرَأَيْتُمْ}} ({{tr:araʾaytum}}) makes the audience evaluators of a case. The sight-root still matters because seeing becomes accountable judgment here: they must consider what follows if the message is from God. The formula belongs to a recurring hypothetical challenge pattern (6:40, 6:47, 10:50, 11:28, 46:10), and the whole conditional chain remains inside this demanded evaluation. Hamza texture and variants mark the opening, but they do not alter the core challenge.

topics.headline: sight-formula demands evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb of seeing functions as a demand for accountable judgment, not a request for eyesight.
topics.reason: The hamza plus plural perfect form governs the following conditional case as a rhetorical challenge formula.

topics.headline: stock formula for uncomfortable hypotheticals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the wording as part of a Quranic challenge pattern that asks opponents to consider the consequences of what they reject (6:40, 6:47, 10:50, 11:28, 46:10).
topics.reason: The concrete references support a formulaic comparison while local syntax keeps the whole ayah under this interrogative frame.

topics.headline: question governs the proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows every later clause as material inside the demanded evaluation rather than as detached information.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence places the conditional chain under the challenge clause.

topics.headline: marked hamza texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the interrogative pivot as acoustically marked, while articulation variants do not change the formula’s argumentative force.
topics.reason: The variant rows are useful for recitation texture, but QAC and local grammar keep the same challenge formula.

words.gloss_range: open conditional particle introducing a suspended evidentiary scenario whose answer is delayed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic particle introducing the concluding declarative verdict

words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) opens the case without immediately giving the answer. Because the condition is allowed to run through origin, rejection, testimony, belief, and arrogance, the listener has to carry the consequence in suspense. The omitted answer becomes part of the pressure: by the time the final verdict arrives, the audience has already been made to supply it. The sound-ring with {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) moves the ayah from conditional testing to emphatic judgment.

topics.headline: condition suspends the answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah hold judgment open while the evidence is stacked clause by clause.
topics.reason: The particle opens a conditional protasis and the following perfect does not force a counterfactual reading.

topics.headline: suppressed apodosis pressures the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing answer makes the audience supply the consequence before the final verdict states the principle.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies a dense protasis, while the closing inna clause functions as the rhetorical landing.

topics.headline: condition-to-verdict particle frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening condition and final emphatic particle as a frame moving from possibility to judgment.
topics.reason: The near-repeat with the later emphatic particle is a coherent discourse and sound observation.

words.gloss_range: past being/source verb with an implied message subject: if it was or is from God
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, occurring, or having a status; locally a source-status test for the implied revelation/message
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) keeps the subject unstated: the message from the prior discourse is the thing being tested. That compressed subject then carries into rejection and comparison. The verb does more than fill grammar; it turns divine provenance into a truth-status question, moving from what the Messenger follows to what the message may be. A comparison with another source-authenticity challenge (4:82) is useful, but here the local frame remains the specific question whether this implied message is from God.

topics.headline: hidden subject keeps the message under review
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks an implied message through origin, rejection, and comparison instead of being handed a freshly named object.
topics.reason: The verb has an implicit masculine singular subject recoverable from prior discourse and continued by later pronouns.

topics.headline: being from God tests truth status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the question as a truth-status test: if the message is from God, rejection becomes misrelation to reality.
topics.reason: The local predicate phrase is source-marking with min and ʿind; the root range can support being or occurring without replacing the source construction.

topics.headline: divine-source authenticity frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the source test alongside another Quranic authenticity challenge (4:82), while the local wording still asks this ayah’s specific conditional question.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete parallel to a similar source frame, but it serves comparison rather than controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: previous revelation claim becomes source question

topics.reason: The row concerns the later arrogance root rather than the local being verb, and it adds no separate payoff for this word.

words.gloss_range: source-marking preposition in a compound divine-provenance phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct source/presence term: from the presence, domain, or side of God

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes provenance the first live issue. Joined to {{ar:عِنْدِ}} ({{tr:ʿindi}}), it marks the message as potentially from God’s own domain, not merely near a sacred idea. Its later recurrence at {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) creates a source parallel: divine origin first, then a witness from a recognized lineage.

topics.headline: source preposition bears the provenance hinge

topics.reason: The preposition governs the ʿind phrase, producing a source construction.

topics.headline: source marker balances divine origin and human witness

topics.reason: The same preposition recurs at word 14 with a different source relation, forming a visible structural parallel.

words.gloss_range: construct source/presence term: from the presence, domain, or side of God
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, presence, being at or with, with related obstinacy forms elsewhere; locally the source-domain noun in construct
words.prose: {{ar:عِنْدِ}} ({{tr:ʿindi}}) thickens the provenance claim. The message is not simply said to be from God in a thin way; the construction says from the presence or domain of God. The root’s nearness field also throws pressure against the later refusal: truth is posed as coming from divine nearness, while the audience is described as standing in arrogant distance. The source phrase also anticipates the surah’s concern with what is with God and what a people fail to know; that pressure is lexical and discourse background, not a change of the local source sense.

topics.headline: presence noun deepens divine source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source claim is grammatically thickened through from, presence, and God rather than stated in a bare formula.
topics.reason: The word is governed by min and in construct with the divine name, matching the local source construction.

topics.headline: presence root set against refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the irony of nearness to truth beside later obstinate refusal, while the local word still means presence or domain.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is useful as contrast, but local grammar selects the locative/source noun rather than an obstinacy adjective.

topics.headline: with-God phrase anticipates knowledge failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the source phrase as part of the surah’s concern with what is with God and what people fail to know.
topics.reason: The contextual row is broad but tied to the local source phrase and not contradicted.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative divine proper name as the subject of the emphatic verdict clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) completes the first source claim: the possible origin is God’s presence, not an unnamed sacred sphere. The root memory around worship, bewilderment, seeking refuge, and turning toward remains background pressure, but the local word is the fixed divine name. Its later return as {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) turns the name into a bookend: God is first the possible source of the message and then the explicit subject of the guidance verdict. The same-surah challenge setting (46:4, 46:9, 46:10) supports that frame without changing the local genitive role.

topics.headline: proper name completes source claim

topics.headline: worship and bewilderment pressure around the name

topics.headline: same-surah challenge formula context

topics.reason: The row is mainly discourse context and is narrowed to formulaic background for the local divine-source phrase.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding the audience’s rejection as another arm of the condition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the rejection clause into the conditional proof. The audience’s act is not an afterthought after the divine-source hypothesis; it is part of the same scenario they must evaluate. As the first of the repeated coordinators, it begins the cumulative chain that stacks origin, rejection, testimony, and arrogance before the suppressed answer.

topics.headline: rejection bound into the protasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the audience’s rejection as part of the same hypothetical case, not a later aside.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates this rejection clause inside the conditional protasis.

topics.headline: serial coordination stacks the evidence

topics.reason: The repeated wa clauses are visible in the protasis and accumulate source, rejection, testimony, and arrogance.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural perfect of rejecting or disbelieving in the implied message through a following bi-object
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, ingratitude, and disbelief; locally active rejection of the implied message/truth claim

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: bound preposition with pronoun suffix marking the object of rejection, chiefly the implied message or truth claim
third-person singular Form IV perfect: he believed or came into faith as response to testimony

words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرْتُمْ}} ({{tr:kafartum}}) names the audience directly: they have rejected it. The following {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) keeps that rejection attached to the implied message rather than letting it float as a general label. The {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) field makes the act feel like covering over evidence, and the later contrast with {{ar:آمَنَ}} ({{tr:āmana}}) turns rejection and belief into the ayah’s moral axis. Within the surah, this is one point in a wider pattern of recognition versus refusal.

topics.headline: bi construction fixes the rejected object

topics.reason: The verb is followed by a bi-prepositional object whose pronoun tracks the implied subject.

topics.headline: covering root makes rejection active

topics.reason: The root-family metaphor is compatible with the local rejection construction.

topics.headline: disbelief opposed to witness belief

topics.reason: The local sequence juxtaposes this plural rejection with the singular witness’s later belief.

topics.headline: local rejection joins a surah pattern

topics.reason: The same-surah rows are coherent discourse background and do not overrule the local construction.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition with pronoun suffix marking the object of rejection, chiefly the implied message or truth claim
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is tiny, but it prevents the rejection from becoming abstract. It governs the pronoun and makes the audience reject something: most immediately the implied message, with the broader divine-source proposition still compressed into the reference. In recitation the particle-suffix bond makes rejection cling to its object.

topics.headline: preposition attaches rejection to its object

topics.reason: The particle governs the 3MS suffix as the prepositional object of the rejection verb.

topics.headline: suffix keeps several referents live

topics.reason: Referent profiles favor the implied message/proposition; broader possibilities survive as compressed referent pressure, not as free ambiguity.

topics.headline: short particle fuses rejection and object

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding the witness clause as another arm of the conditional proof

The repeated connector escalates the scenario from your rejection to an external witness, increasing the weight before any answer is stated.

words.prose: {{ar:شَهِدَ}} ({{tr:shahida}}) turns the condition into a forensic scene. The act of testimony is directed by the later {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) phrase toward the comparable matter, so it is not just someone speaking. The {{ar:ش ه د}} ({{tr:sh-h-d}}) range lets testimony feel grounded in presence to truth, and the immediate pairing with {{ar:شَاهِدٌ}} ({{tr:shāhidun}}) concentrates the root: testimony and witness stand side by side while the answer remains delayed.

topics.headline: testimony directed through ʿalā

topics.headline: condition becomes a courtroom-like scene

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular active-participle witness: an unspecified role-bearing attester within the proof
words.root_gloss_range: presence, witnessing, testimony, and witness identity; locally the nominative subject characterized by witnessing

One role-bearing witness from a recognized scriptural lineage is enough to expose the plural audience. The participle makes witnessing a characterization, and the root reprise with {{ar:شَهِدَ}} ({{tr:shahida}}) makes the forensic scene dense: verb, agent, lineage, and response converge into proof against the audience. The motif also links to external recognition by Israelite knowledge (26:197), while the local phrase remains an unnamed witness.

topics.headline: one syllable turns evidence into reaction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between direct belief after evidence and the later coordinated arrogance.
topics.reason: The fa here differs from the later wa, encoding a different logical relation between clauses.

words.gloss_range: third-person singular Form IV perfect: he believed or came into faith as response to testimony
words.root_gloss_range: security, safety, trust, faith, and giving or entering assurance; locally the witness’s singular belief response
words.prose: {{ar:آمَنَ}} ({{tr:āmana}}) isolates the witness’s response: he believed. Its singular form stands against the plural addressees who rejected and became arrogant, so one person’s recognition outweighs a crowd’s refusal. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field makes belief feel like entering trustful safety, and Form IV supports an active faith-response, though the local grammar simply states that he believed. The conflict continues through related surah scenes (46:11, 46:17).

topics.headline: one witness against plural refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one person’s recognition set against the plural audience’s rejection and arrogance.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as third-person masculine singular, while the surrounding audience verbs are second-person plural.

topics.headline: belief as entering trustful safety
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears belief as movement into trust and security, not bare intellectual assent.
topics.reason: The root field supports security-belief pressure in the local faith response.

topics.headline: Form IV presents active entry into faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the morphology as an active faith-response, while local grammar simply states that the witness believed.
topics.reason: The form observation is useful, but claims of causative self-securing are narrowed to active faith-response rather than a separate caused object.

topics.headline: faith opposed to covering rejection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees faith and covering rejection structure the ayah’s conflict, with related surah scenes at 46:11 and 46:17.
topics.reason: The local sequence directly juxtaposes the witness’s belief with the addressees’ rejection and arrogance.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle with contrastive force before the audience’s arrogant refusal

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: result particle marking the witness’s belief as a direct consequence inside the conditional scenario

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not make the next act neutral. After {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) sent testimony directly into belief, this connector sets the audience’s arrogance as the counter-response. It can hold both coordination and contrast: while he believed, you grew arrogant. Because it introduces the last human act before the verdict, it seals the cumulative indictment.

topics.headline: coordination creates a counter-response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the audience’s arrogance as a counter-response to the witness’s belief, with simultaneity and contrast both in play.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the audience’s arrogance after the fa-result belief clause and can carry contrastive force in context.

topics.headline: arrogance positioned immediately before judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last human act named before the divine maxim is the addressees’ arrogant refusal.
topics.reason: The coordinated arrogance clause completes the protasis before the emphatic verdict.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural Form X perfect: you sought or acted arrogantly great in response to evidence
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, largeness, importance, and arrogant self-magnification; locally self-exalting refusal
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ}} ({{tr:istakbartum}}) is the audience’s counter-response. The plural addressees set themselves high against the singular witness’s belief, inverting person, number, and moral direction. The {{ar:ك ب ر}} ({{tr:k-b-r}}) field makes arrogance a misuse of greatness, and Form X presents it as claimed or sought greatness for the self. Wider scriptural scenes of arrogant refusal after truth, including Iblis’s refusal (2:34, 7:13, 38:74), amplify the type while the local charge remains aimed at this audience.

topics.headline: plural self-exaltation counters one believer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees person, number, and moral valence invert: one witness believes, while the plural audience claims greatness.
topics.reason: QAC marks second-person plural perfect Form X, contrasted with the preceding third-person singular belief verb.

topics.headline: greatness becomes arrogant self-inflation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears refusal as inflated self-assessment before evidence, not mere disagreement.
topics.reason: The root range supports greatness-to-arrogance pressure in this Form X verb.

topics.headline: Form X depicts seeking or claiming greatness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices morphology presenting arrogance as self-claimed greatness rather than actual greatness.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form X and second-person plural, matching the reflexive/estimative CRITICAL claim.

topics.headline: archetypal refusal after truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the addressees’ pride against the scriptural type of refusal after truth, including Iblis’s refusal (2:34, 7:13, 38:74), while the local subject remains this audience.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels illuminate the arrogance type but do not replace the local addressees with those scenes.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle introducing the concluding declarative verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: open conditional particle introducing a suspended evidentiary scenario whose answer is delayed

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) moves the ayah from conditional testing into asserted judgment. The evidence has been staged, the human responses named, and now the closing clause states the principle. The ending does not rest on the witness’s biography; it lands on guidance and injustice. The near-sound with {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) helps frame the movement from possibility to verdict.

topics.headline: inna turns hypothesis into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse shift from testing a case to announcing the ruling that the case has made unavoidable.
topics.reason: The particle opens the concluding inna clause after the conditional protasis.

topics.headline: closure lands on divine principle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah does not end on the witness’s story but on a general rule of guidance and injustice.
topics.reason: The inna clause is the closing verdict content of the quoted challenge.

topics.headline: condition-to-emphasis sound frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening conditional particle answered by a near-sounding emphatic particle.
topics.reason: The sound and particle contrast coherently frames hypothesis versus verdict.

words.gloss_range: accusative divine proper name as the subject of the emphatic verdict clause
words.root_gloss_range: worship, deity, turning toward, and divine-name derivation; locally the fixed proper name functioning as inna’s governed subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive divine proper name completing the source phrase

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) names God as the subject of the verdict. The same name that appeared in the source phrase now stands in the judgment clause, with case shift tracking role shift: from {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) as possible origin to {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) as the One who does not guide the wrongdoing people. The bookend binds provenance and moral outcome together.

topics.headline: divine name is governed subject of judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees God as the explicit grammatical subject behind the guidance principle.
topics.reason: The name is accusative as the ism of inna, while the following verbal clause supplies the predicate content.

topics.headline: same name shifts from source to judge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the divine name from possible origin at the beginning to agent of judgment at the end.
topics.reason: The same proper name appears first in genitive source construction and then as accusative subject of the verdict.

words.gloss_range: negation particle before an imperfect verb, forming a general non-guidance principle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negated imperfect of guiding: ongoing divine guidance withheld from the wrongdoing people

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) makes the verdict negative at the decisive point. With the imperfect {{ar:يَهْدِي}} ({{tr:yahdī}}), it states an ongoing principle rather than a single past event: guidance is not granted to the class about to be named. This negation is also the consequence the suspended condition has been pushing toward. Its compact cadence helps the closing formula land firmly.

topics.headline: lā plus imperfect states an ongoing principle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verdict as a general rule of withheld guidance, not a one-time refusal.
topics.reason: The negation particle precedes an imperfect verb in the closing maxim.

topics.headline: negation supplies the withheld consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denied guidance as the consequence the conditional had pressured them to supply.
topics.reason: The negative predicate content answers the suppressed apodosis through the verdict clause.

topics.headline: compact negative cadence closes the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the compactness of the negated guidance formula at the close.
topics.reason: The sound row reinforces the local closing formula without altering grammar.

words.gloss_range: negated imperfect of guiding: ongoing divine guidance withheld from the wrongdoing people
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, directing, showing a way, and gift/bestowal pressure; locally withheld guidance under negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negation particle before an imperfect verb, forming a general non-guidance principle

words.prose: {{ar:يَهْدِي}} ({{tr:yahdī}}) is the predicate core of the closing maxim. Under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), guidance is presented as ongoing divine action withheld from a morally defined people. The {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) field makes the loss more than missing information: direction is also a bestowed benefit, so non-guidance withholds a gift. The wording belongs to a recurring non-guidance formula (2:258, 3:86, 5:51, 6:144, 9:19, 9:109, 28:50, 46:10, 61:7, 62:5) and later contrasts with the jinn guiding their people at 46:30.

topics.headline: imperfect guidance withheld as continuing action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing maxim turns on ongoing divine guidance being withheld from a morally defined people.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is negated by lā and takes the people as object.

topics.headline: guidance is direction and bestowed benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the loss as withheld direction and withheld gift, while the local verb still means guiding.
topics.reason: The gift/bestowal branch survives as root pressure, but local grammar selects guidance under negation.

topics.headline: recurring verdict formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the local clause as a repeated Quranic legal-moral formula rather than an ad hoc ending (2:258, 3:86, 5:51, 6:144, 9:19, 9:109, 28:50, 46:10, 61:7, 62:5).
topics.reason: The exact negated guidance plus wrongdoing-people pattern recurs across the cited verses.

topics.headline: local denial contrasted with later guidance response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing denial connected to the ayah’s rejection field and later contrasted by the jinn guiding their people at 46:30.
topics.reason: The same-surah reference gives a concrete contrast in guidance and people language.

words.gloss_range: definite collective object: the people/community being denied guidance and then morally qualified
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, and people/community; locally a collective body defined by the following wrongdoing label

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite plural active participle: the wrongdoing people as a sustained moral category

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-qawma}}) gathers the audience into a definite collective object: the people. The verdict is not aimed at an abstraction but at a corporate body, many treated as one. The {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) field can make that body feel like a stance or what a community stands upon, though the local sense remains people. The noun then waits for {{ar:ٱلظَّالِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimīna}}) to disclose the moral category, and the surah later answers the negative people-language with a positive guidance scene at 46:30.

topics.headline: the people as a defined judged class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees many opponents gathered as one definite corporate object of the verdict.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, accusative, and the object of the guidance verb, then qualified by the following adjective.

topics.headline: people defined by what they stand upon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses corporate stance in the people-word, while local grammar keeps the meaning as people or community.
topics.reason: The standing root pressure survives as image-pressure around collective identity, not a separate physical-standing sense.

topics.headline: community language gathers rejection and verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees people-language tie guidance, rejection, and later response patterns across the surah, including the positive answer at 46:30.
topics.reason: The contextual rows are tied to the local object of non-guidance and same-surah people language.

topics.headline: noun waits for final moral qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the object held briefly until the final word names its moral condition.
topics.reason: The adjective follows as a qualifying participle, making the noun a suspense point before the label.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle: the wrongdoing people as a sustained moral category
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, injustice, putting things in the wrong place, and darkness; locally the final participial label qualifying the people
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّالِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-ẓālimīna}}) is the final moral label. As an active participle, it classifies the people by a sustained trait rather than a single slip. The {{ar:ظ ل م}} ({{tr:ẓ-l-m}}) field lets wrongdoing feel like misplacement and darkening: evidence, belief, and guidance have been put out of place. The phrase forms a recurring verdict category, and here it names arrogant rejection as wrongdoing. Because the ayah closes on this word, the final key is ethical, not merely evidentiary.

topics.headline: active participle makes wrongdoing a sustained trait
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people classified by an ongoing character, not a single isolated mistake.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite plural active participle qualifying the people.

topics.headline: wrongdoing as misplacement and darkening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears rejection and arrogance named as moral misplacement that darkens access to guidance.
topics.reason: The root range supports misplacement/darkness pressure in the closing moral label.

topics.headline: fixed non-guidance label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final label as part of a recurring verdict formula in which arrogant rejection becomes wrongdoing.
topics.reason: The phrase with the people noun recurs as a guidance-denial formula and locally classifies the addressees.

topics.headline: ayah closes on ethical diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final interpretive key land as moral, not merely evidentiary.
topics.reason: The final position and sound texture give the label terminal weight.

topics.headline: wrongdoing resonates with nearby recompense scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the label participate in the surah’s recurring treatment of wrongdoing and recompense.
topics.reason: The same-surah row gives coherent discourse background for the final label.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command, alerting question, conditional provenance claim, double witness wording, and split response form a single hearing-like construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker compels the addressees to entertain divine provenance, then places informed testimony beside their covering response. Belief and self-exaltation become rival reactions to the same evidence, and the closing guidance clause evaluates that reaction rather than adding an unrelated maxim.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance supplies the public opening of an evidentiary challenge.
Alerting inquiry makes the question a demand for considered disclosure, not a request for visual description.
Knowledge-based declaration gives the witness an evidentiary function within the conditional test.
Concealment of truth makes disbelief an active treatment of disclosed evidence.
Heart-settling assent supplies the witness's responsive outcome.
Self-exaltation supplies the addressees' opposed response to the same disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states that disbelief is wrong and mentions a supporting witness.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a counterfactual evidentiary hearing in which testimony exposes two incompatible responses to one disclosed claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A witness identified through Israelite descent testifies concerning its like.
baseline_models.mechanism: Genealogical provenance locates the witness within a formed tradition, while likeness supplies a corresponding object. The witness is therefore relevant not merely as an individual observer but as someone able to recognize continuity across related forms.

activation_trace.role: Descent and attributed origin situate the witness inside a lineage competent to recognize continuity.
Correspondence with a peer or analogue supplies the object of the witness's recognition.
Presence joined to observation makes the witness a situated recognizer rather than a detached credential.

changed_reading.before: An Israelite happens to agree that the new message is similar to something true.
changed_reading.after: Lineage and correspondence work together: a witness formed by an earlier tradition recognizes a related form and responds to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing clause joins guidance, a people, and wrongdoing immediately after the opposed responses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance is gentle direction toward a way, while wrongdoing is both displacement and withholding a due right. The collective is not merely labeled; its handling of the evidence places it out of alignment with the direction it is being shown.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies the directional meaning of guidance.
A human collective makes the consequence social and shared rather than merely private.
Putting something outside its fitting place supplies a spatial model for mishandling evidence.
Withholding a right makes the misalignment also an unjust refusal of what the evidence is due.

changed_reading.before: God withholds guidance from people already classified as wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: The group's displacement and withholding of acknowledged evidence is itself the orientation that leaves gentle direction unrealized.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The witness believes, whereas the addressed plural seeks greatness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The response contrast can be social as well as inward. Settled trust accepts testimony, while inherited rank and competitive superiority make acceptance feel like loss of standing.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled confidence supply a noncompetitive mode of receiving the testimony.
Elevated honor and leadership supply the status that acceptance may appear to threaten.
Competitive overcoming turns rejection into an attempt to defeat the witness rather than weigh the testimony.

changed_reading.before: Belief and arrogance are simply opposite personal traits.
changed_reading.after: The response split also depicts a status contest over who may recognize and authorize truth first.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening description of a delivered written object from God makes the focus conditional test a provenance test for an already characterized book, not an abstract possibility about an unspecified object.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence supply the focus claim's source relation to God.
Caused descent and delivery identify a directional transfer from source to recipients.
Ordered writing and the written object identify what is being delivered and later tested.

structural_cues: 46:2 states delivery of the book from God before 46:10 repeats the source relation inside an explicit conditional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a book delivered from God and a later conditional about something from God; I infer that the conditional reopens the stated provenance for adversarial examination. A live alternative is that the pronoun ranges over revelation more broadly than the book as a bounded artifact.

changed_reading.before: If it is from God introduces a free-standing hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: The conditional asks the audience to face the risk of rejecting a delivered book whose divine provenance has already been asserted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fabrication charge is answered first by God's sufficient witness between the parties; the focus then introduces a knowledgeable human witness. The Israelite witness is therefore a publicly legible layer within a larger attestation structure, not the sole foundation of the claim.

activation_trace.role: Invented falsehood supplies the accusation that makes attestation necessary.
Standing for the matter until sufficiency is reached establishes the divine witness as adequate in itself.
Knowledge-based declaration supplies the first explicit witness in the sequence.
The repeated knowledgeable declaration adds a humanly accessible attestation without replacing the prior one.

structural_cues: The singular witness term recurs from the divine between-party witness in 46:8 to the Israelite witness in 46:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the fabrication charge, a sufficient divine witness, and then a human witness; I infer accumulation of attestations. The human witness could alternatively function only as a separate example rather than as a deliberately layered second register.

changed_reading.before: The Israelite witness is the decisive external proof on which the claim depends.
changed_reading.after: The Israelite witness translates an already sufficient divine attestation into a form publicly testable within human historical knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial that the messenger is unprecedented, followed by the prior Book of Moses as an exemplar and the present book as confirming, turns likeness from loose resemblance into diachronic scriptural correspondence. Israelite descent becomes evidentially relevant because the witness stands within the line being compared.

activation_trace.role: Lineage and attributed origin place the witness inside the earlier scriptural community.
Following an exemplar makes likeness an operative correspondence rather than decorative similarity.
Origination without a prior model supplies the novelty explicitly denied of the messenger.
Temporal precedence supplies the earlier position of Moses's book in the comparison.
The written-object branch places both books in the same inspectable textual class.
An exemplar followed by others gives the earlier book a guiding, pattern-setting role.
Truthfulness in statement supplies the confirming relation of the later book to the earlier one.

structural_cues: 46:9 denies unprecedented novelty, 46:10 inserts the Israelite witness, and 46:12 names Moses's earlier book and a confirming present book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-novelty, an Israelite witness to likeness, and two temporally related books; I infer that the witness recognizes scriptural continuity. A live alternative is that likeness concerns the witness's testimony or experience rather than the two books directly.

changed_reading.before: Its like means an unspecified similar truth or event.
changed_reading.after: Its like can name a patterned correspondence between the present book and the Mosaic textual line recognized from within that line.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah voices the status logic latent in the focus contrast: others' arriving first is treated as evidence against the good. Failure to accept guidance then inverts truth into falsehood and continuity into discrediting oldness.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent marks the witness's prior uptake of the evidence.
Rank and leadership supply the social standing defended by refusal.
Advancing first supplies the explicit grievance that lower-status believers have arrived ahead.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction models the rhetorical inversion of evidence into fraud.
Antiquity supplies the age label used to turn continuity from support into a defect.

structural_cues: 46:11 immediately restages the focus split as disbelievers speaking about those who believed and preceded them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the claim that believers would not have preceded the speakers if the message were good; I infer a status-preserving premise behind the claim. The line can also be read as chronological skepticism without a fully specified class hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: You were arrogant names generic pride after an otherwise intellectual disagreement.
changed_reading.after: Arrogance is a social filter that rejects evidence because accepting it would concede precedence and authority to those who believed first.

context_deltas.mechanism: Upright standing after confession contrasts with self-exaltation on earth without right. These recurrences make the focus people a collective posture: one group aligns itself after speaking, while the other elevates itself without warranted placement and thereby resists direction.

activation_trace.role: The collective branch supplies the group whose shared posture is evaluated.
Misplacement supplies the focus group's governing spatial defect.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the positive collective posture after confession.
Self-magnification supplies the opposing posture enacted on earth.
Fixed entitlement marks the right that the asserted elevation lacks.

structural_cues: The sequence opposes 46:13's standing straight after speech to 46:20's seeking greatness on earth without right.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upright standing, self-exaltation without right, and the focus label for a people; I infer that bodily-spatial posture models communal orientation toward evidence. The focus noun can still remain a simple collective designation without carrying every standing sense of its root.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoing people are a fixed category to whom guidance is denied.
changed_reading.after: The people are also constituted by a shared posture: unauthorized elevation and misplacement oppose the upright alignment in which guidance can be followed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible approaching formation is confidently misread as beneficial rain, and later sight, hearing, and hearts are said not to avail amid knowing denial. The focus inquiry therefore tests interpretive and moral reception, not whether sensory evidence ever reached the audience.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye and insight anchors the focus question in perception that requires judgment.
An appearance emerging from a direction supplies the ambiguous object that is visibly present yet misclassified.
Water descending from cloud supplies the hoped-for category imposed on the approaching sign.
Physical eyesight supplies perceptual capacity that proves insufficient by itself.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the interpretive center that also fails to yield reception.
Denial despite knowledge explains why available faculties do not become responsive recognition.

structural_cues: 46:24 joins seeing with a mistaken this-is judgment; 46:26 repeats the sensory faculties and locates failure in denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, misclassification, intact faculties, and knowing denial; I infer that the focus question probes construal and response rather than raw access. The cloud episode can alternatively remain an independent warning scene with only an analogical link to textual recognition.

changed_reading.before: Have you considered merely asks the audience to inspect enough evidence.
changed_reading.after: The question tests whether already available perception will be construed faithfully; seeing can coexist with covering, while the witness's distinction is receptive recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later hearers attend silently, turn toward their people, identify a delivered book after Moses as confirming what preceded it and guiding to an extended straight way, then call for an answer. This reenacts the focus sequence as a repeatable process: reception, recognition of correspondence, belief, and transmitted warning across another community.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge-based declaration anchors the later hearing-and-reporting sequence to the focus witness.
Correspondence supplies the focus relation that the later hearers articulate as confirmation.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception deeper than acoustic contact.
Attentive silence supplies the disciplined condition under which recognition forms.
Turning the face toward a destination supplies the movement from reception to communal transmission.
Delivery from above lets the new hearers identify the same provenance tested in the focus.
Sequence after what came before locates the heard book explicitly after Moses.
Truthfulness supplies the validating relation the hearers perceive between texts.
An extended traveled way makes guidance a traversable continuity rather than a bare verdict.
Answering speech converts recognized correspondence into the response urged on the hearers' people.

structural_cues: 46:29-31 forms a continuous reception-to-warning narrative, and its report explicitly names a book after Moses before calling the hearers' people to answer and believe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attentive hearing, Mosaic succession, confirmation, guidance, return, and summons; I infer that this sequence reenacts and generalizes the focus witness mechanism. A live alternative is that the later community's conversion is parallel but not intended to explain the Israelite witness specifically.

changed_reading.before: The Israelite witness is an exceptional corroborator whose identity alone carries the point.
changed_reading.after: The named witness is one instance of a reproducible recognition-and-transmission process that can cross communities while preserving Mosaic correspondence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers a conditional question while response remains open; the later scene presents the denied reality, asks whether it is not true, receives explicit assent, and turns the proposition into experienced consequence. Eventual recognition is therefore distinct from guidance accepted in time.

activation_trace.role: Alerting inquiry supplies the earlier open cross-examination.
Concealment of truth supplies the response whose consequences are later exposed.
Presentation before sight turns the earlier hypothetical object into unavoidable display.
State-negating denial supplies the confirmatory question that corners the respondents into assent.
Reality fixed against falsehood names what can no longer be covered.
Experiential testing converts belated verbal recognition into personally undergone consequence.

structural_cues: 46:10 asks an open if-question about truth and response; 46:34 asks a present demonstrative question and records the respondents' yes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two dialogic examinations, early conditional and late demonstrative; I infer a temporal window in which recognition can still become guidance. The later scene may instead function only as judgment rhetoric without directly defining guidance in 46:10.

changed_reading.before: Failure of guidance means the addressees will never recognize the truth.
changed_reading.after: They may be forced into recognition later; the denied guidance is timely, responsive orientation, not the impossibility of eventual acknowledgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the locative use normally selects nearness, while resistance is a distant branch of the same focus root. It remains anchored at the provenance phrase and visibly sharpens the response contrast, but downstream prose should present it only as root-level resonance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The single focus occurrence of the source-locative root stands between the divine-origin condition and the addressees' refusal.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence supply the ordinary provenance relation to God.
Obdurate deviation and resistance to acknowledged truth supply a latent counterimage enacted by the refusal.

changed_reading.before: From God is only a neutral source marker.
changed_reading.after: At root-resonance level, the source marker becomes a hinge between nearness to divine provenance and the obdurate resistance that turns away from it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because the honey-in-wax branch is remote from juridical testimony. It remains doubly anchored in the focus witness and covering roots and produces a coherent hidden-value image, but it should be rendered only as an exploratory echo, never as the lexical sense of witness here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places witness language directly beside a root whose central material action is covering.

activation_trace.role: Honey held in wax supplies an image of valuable content present inside a containing layer.
Material covering supplies the action that can keep already present evidentiary value from view.

changed_reading.before: The witness is only an external person opposed by disbelief.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, testimony is valuable content already present under a covering, intensifying disbelief as concealment rather than absence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the non-dominant mapped root supplies forceful breaking far from the evident guidance form. The split inventory is still anchored to the exact focus root and yields a contrast with gentle direction, but downstream prose must mark it as a form-distant activation and must not translate the verb as breaking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus guidance root carries both its dominant directional inventory and a non-dominant mapped inventory in the packet.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies the evident focus action.
Severe breaking and demolition supply a contrastive endpoint when gentle reorientation is refused.

changed_reading.before: Not guiding is a simple absence of directional help.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, refused gentle direction casts a distant shadow of forceful breaking, contrasting two modes of encounter without changing the verb's lexical sense.

strongest_changes: The focus reads as an evidentiary hearing nested inside the surah's layered witness structure.
Likeness becomes diachronic correspondence with the Mosaic textual line rather than unspecified similarity.
Arrogance becomes status-preserving refusal of evidence after others have believed first.
The later attentive hearers reproduce the witness process across another community.
The final compelled acknowledgment separates eventual recognition from timely guidance.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah concentrates provenance, testimony, correspondence, belief, status, collective orientation, and guidance into one conditional. Context does not collapse these into a single proof; it makes several mechanisms coexist, especially textual continuity, social precedence, receptive perception, and repeatable outsider attestation.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent and scope of its like may be the book, its message, a prior testimony, or a corresponding revelatory pattern.
The witness's Israelite identity may function chiefly as historical competence, communal contrast, or both.
The social-rank reading of precedence is strongly suggested but the packet does not specify a concrete class identity.
The material and split-root outliers should remain diagnostic resonances rather than lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Embodied corroboration across communities.** ش ه د B001 is presence with witnessing and B002 is testimony from knowledge; the verb-noun pairing `شهد شاهد` intensifies both act and role. `من بني إسرائيل` locates the witness in a lineage, and `على مثله` makes resemblance the object of testimony. I infer that cross-community presence tests the claim of unprecedented invention. The ayah reads as corroboration embodied in a socially locatable witness, not as an abstract comparison alone.
2. **Self-magnification blocks a gently indicated route.** ك ب ر B006 is grandeur and self-magnification; ه د ي B001 is gentle guidance toward a way or truth. The structural contrast is witness-belief versus audience self-exaltation. I infer that making the self large prevents evidence from functioning as a guide. `لا يهدي القوم الظالمين` therefore reads as the result of a posture that refuses to be led after situated testimony.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The hidden jinn witnesses of 46:29–30 were the surprise: they too recognize continuity with Moses and believe, so corroboration is not confined to the named human lineage. Their response reinforces the contrast between evidence-led assent and self-magnification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A lineage-bearer recognizes a built counterpart.** The doubled `شَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ` activates ش ه د B001/B002, presence and testimony from knowledge. `بَنِى` activates ب ن ي B007, filiation and belonging derived from a source, while `مِثْلِهِ` activates م ث ل B001, structural likeness, and B010, action patterned after a model. The preceding ayah denies unprecedented messengership; 46:12 names an earlier book as guide and mercy and the present one as confirming. The packet gives lineage, likeness, and textual confirmation; I infer that inherited proximity to an earlier message equips the witness to recognize recurring structure. His testimony is therefore not an appeal to ancestry alone but a cross-instance comparison within a built transmission lineage.

2. **The two reactions reveal posture, not unequal evidence.** `فَـَٔامَنَ` activates ء م ن B002, trusting confirmation, and B001, settled security; `ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ` activates ك ب ر B006, self-magnification that refuses submission to truth. Both reactions follow the same conditional source and witness. The packet gives a common evidentiary input and divergent responses; I infer that self-ranking makes acceptance feel like a loss of station, whereas confirmation permits the heart to settle. The contrast changes the ayah from a bare believer/unbeliever division into a test of whether evidence can revise social self-placement.

3. **Misplacement breaks guidance’s route.** `يَهْدِى` activates ه د ي B001/B002, gentle indication of a road and its intended course; `ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ` permits ظ ل م B004, putting an act at the wrong place or time, and B008, withholding a due. `مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ` directly uses ع ن د B004, proximity and source, while the same root’s B001 image of knowing resistance is activated by `ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ`. The packet supplies a source, a recognizable counterpart, and refusal; I infer that elevating the self over the witnessed source puts the evaluator and evidence in reversed positions. “Does not guide” then describes a route disabled by deliberate misorientation, not a shortage of signs.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:12 supplied the witness’s likely comparison mechanism without importing an identity for him: the earlier book is an exemplar through أ م م B009 and the present book confirms through ص د ق B004. The later ayah made `عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِ` at 46:10 read as informed structural recognition grounded in a textual lineage, not resemblance asserted in the abstract.

baseline.text: De ki: “Söyleyin, ya o Allah katındansa ve siz onu inkâr ettiyseniz; İsrailoğullarından bir tanık da onun benzerine tanıklık edip inanmışken siz büyüklük tasladıysanız?” Allah zalimler topluluğunu doğru yola iletmez.

findings.text: Soyu ve bilgi geleneği belirli bir tanığın yapısal benzerliği tanıması, doğrulamayı soyut bir iddia olmaktan çıkarıp topluluklar arası, yerleşik bir karşılaştırmaya dönüştürür.
Aynı kanıt karşısında kendini büyütmek, değerlendirenle kanıtın yerini tersine çevirir ve nazikçe gösterilen yolun kişiyi yönlendirmesini engeller.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A true communication leaves ordered, transmissible marks that can be read, witnessed, and followed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The branch images turn abstract proof into a material chain of stitching, inscription, landmarks, testimony, and tracked passage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Disclosure passes through witness, tongue, and messenger
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Meaning becomes public through an articulate carrier and is then secured by present or knowledgeable testimony.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: A present witness (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`); declaration grounded in knowledge (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); meaning disclosed by word or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); clear articulation (`quranic:root_000996:B001/m01`); the tongue as language and message (`quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `كفى به شهيدا بيني وبينكم` (46:8), `شاهد من بني إسرائيل` (46:10), `بلسان عربي` (46:12), and `ينذر` (46:12).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The truth claim is not only a text-object; it is voiced in a legible tongue and enters a field of accountable witnessing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Falsehood is manufactured by joining or covering material, then maintained by redirecting perception and trapping inquiry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lexical branches materialize polemical labels as workshop operations and hunting techniques.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Denial works by covering and redirecting sight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An encountered disclosure is covered, turned aside, or made to appear in a displaced direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Directional reversal (`quranic:root_000041:B001/m01`); magic as perceptual diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`); physical covering (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); blockage of truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); turning one's side away (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `سحر مبين` (46:7), `كفرتم به` (46:10), `إفك قديم` (46:11), and `وهم عما أنذروا معرضون` (46:3).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The opponents' labels describe a distortion in the message, while the branch pattern relocates the distortion into their own acts of covering and directional refusal.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözü sesle dışa çıkarılan ve harflerden oluşan sözlü ifade çekirdeğinde toplar; ad biçimleri de aynı alana bağlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiilsel söyleme işlemini korur.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.

Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme
concept_gloss.applicability: Duyusal görme ile ona benzetilen içsel kavrayışın birlikte amaçlandığı genel anlatımda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözle algılama çekirdeğini ve içsel kavrayış uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım yalnızca duyusal algıyı veya doğrudan göz tanıklığını gerektirdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal görmeyi ve doğrudan tanıklığı açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İçsel kavrayışla görme olanağını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle değil, zihinsel veya içsel bir kavrayışla algılama bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göz işlevine benzetilen içsel algılama yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Duyusal görme ve doğrudan göz tanıklığı yönünü yitirir.

yeni ayı görebilmek için dikkatle bakmaya çalıştık

error_profile.loses: Gözle algılama ve doğrudan görme çekirdeğini siler.
error_profile.adds: Bir konu hakkında düşünce veya kanı anlamını öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Zihinsel yargı dalıyla kolayca karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçsel kavrayışa uzanabilmesi ve doğrudan tanıklık anlatımlarını kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Göz duyusunu, gören organı ve bakışın fiziksel açılışını ayrıca adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da göz yoluyla görsel algılamayı merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algılanan şeyi görme eylemini ve bunun içsel kavrayış uzantısını anlatır; komşu dal ise göz duyusunu ve gözün görür duruma getirilmesini de kendi çekirdeğine alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçsel kavrayışı ve genel görsel algıyı doğrudan tanıklığın yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüz yüze görme ile kesinlik ve ilk elden tanıklık vurgusunu çekirdeğe yerleştirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi doğrudan gözle görme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kapsamı genel görmeden içsel kavrayışa uzanır; komşu dal doğrudan karşılaşma ve gözle kesin tanıklık sınırında daha dardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi algılamış olmayı ve görmenin gerçekleşmesini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi anlamak için bakışı sürdürme, sınama ve dikkatle inceleme sürecini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gözün bir nesneye yönelmesini gerektirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algının sonucunu veya gerçekleşmesini anlatır; komşu dal ise algıya ulaşmak için yapılan dikkatli ve süreli bakışı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; göz duyusu, doğrudan tanıklık ve dikkatli bakış en yararlı sınırları verdi, öteki adaylar ya uzak temalıydı ya da bu ayrımları yineledi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görüş, kanı ve düşünerek karar verme çekirdektir; bilme, sanma ve danışma yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın zihinsel yargı ile düşünme, danışma ve göz tanıklığına bağlı sanma kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir konu hakkında düşünüp zihinde bir görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturmaktır. Derinlemesine düşünme bu sonuca götüren süreçtir; danışma başka birinin yargısını isteme, belirli tümce yapılarıysa bilme ya da sanma değeridir.

facets.statement: Bir konu hakkında zihinde görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturma.
Bir görüşe ulaşmak için konuyu ağır ağır ve farklı yönleriyle düşünme.
Başka birinden görüş isteme veya belirli bir yapıda bilme ve sanma bildirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zihinsel görüş ve inancı ortaklaştırır; düşünerek görüşe varma, bir başkasına danışma ve belirli yapılardaki bilme ya da sanma değerleri bu eksenin bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir konu hakkında zihinsel değerlendirme yapıp görüş veya yargı oluşturma çekirdeğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşünme sürecini ve bunun görüş ya da yargı sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir durum hakkında kesin bilgi değil, kanı veya sanı bildirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zihinsel yargı ve kanı oluşturma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Danışma ve uzun düşünme süreçlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir başkasından değerlendirme veya öneri istenen danışma yapılarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının zihinsel yargısını isteme uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendi görüşünü oluşturması ve bilme değeri dışarıda kalır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bilmek, sanmak veya öyle olduğuna inanmak
düşünüp taşınmak ve bir görüşe varmak

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi kavrama çağrışımının sınırlı bir bölümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Görüş oluşturma, düşünüp taşınma ve danışma sınırlarını siler.
error_profile.adds: Duyusal göz algısını birincil anlam gibi öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Gözle algılama dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Görüş, kanı, bilme, sanma ve danışmayı düşünme sürecinin yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir iş üzerinde düşünme ve ağırdan değerlendirme sürecini kendi başına merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir konu üzerinde düşünerek değerlendirme yapmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düşünmenin sonucundaki görüşü ve ona bağlı kullanımları kapsar; komşu dal esas olarak düşünme ve değerlendirme sürecini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir görüş veya yargı oluşturup onu benimseme yönünün bulunması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kararsızlık, kuşku ve iki olasılık arasında gidip gelme durumunu merkez alması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir konu hakkında zihinsel değerlendirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir yargıya yönelir veya varır; komşu dal yargının kurulmasını engelleyen kuşku ve kararsızlığı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her düzeydeki görüşü, kanıyı ve görüş istemeyi kapsayan geniş zihinsel alan.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Görüşün olgun, sağlam ve iyice kurulmuş olmasını zorunlu kılan nitelik.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kurulmuş bir zihinsel yargıyı konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görüşün niteliği hakkında güvence vermez; komşu dal yalnızca olgunlaşmış ve sağlamlaştırılmış görüşü anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açıkça uyuyan kişinin uykuda gördüğü şeyi ve bunun çoğulunu bildirir. Uyanıkken gözle görmek, zihinsel görüş ve düşü yorumlama bu kimliğin parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca uyku sırasında görülen düşü adlandırır; uyanık algı ve yorumlama ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal uyku sırasında görülen düş anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve başka yapılara bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Uyuyan bir kişinin uyku sırasında gördüğü düş veya düş görüntüsüdür. Adın çoğul biçimi de aynı türden birden çok uyku deneyimini bildirir.

facets.statement: Uyku sırasında görülen düş veya görüntü.
Aynı uyku deneyiminin tekil ve çoğul adlandırmaları.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı uyku sırasında görülen düş olarak tanımlar ve tekil adın birden çok düşü bildiren çoğul biçimini de kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Uyuyan kişinin gördüğü tek bir düşü veya genel olarak bu uyku deneyimini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku koşulunu ve görülen düş içeriğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uyku sırasında bir görüntü veya olay dizisi yaşama eylemi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku içindeki görsel ya da yaşantısal deneyimi doğal Türkçeyle korur.
Göz önünde beliren bir görüntü düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.adds: Uyku dışında sezgi, tasarım veya uyanık görüntü anlamlarını da çağırır.
error_profile.collision: Uyanık görme ve zihinsel kavrayışla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uyku sırasında görülen şeyi ve onun çoğul adını yalın biçimde bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Cinsel içerikli uyku deneyimini ve görülmemiş bir düşü gördüğünü ileri sürmeyi de kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: düş ile geniş uyku görüsü alanı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal uyuyan kişinin gördüğü düşü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalın düş adıdır; komşu dal aynı çekirdeğe ek olarak özel bir bedensel uyku deneyimini ve gerçekte görülmeyen düşü gördüğünü söyleme durumunu içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uyku sırasında görülen düş içeriğinin kendisini adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Görülen düşü çözümleyip görünür içeriğinden başka bir anlama aktarma işlemini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı uyku deneyimini konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görülen şeydir; komşu dal bu şey üzerinde sonradan yürütülen anlamlandırma ve yorumlama işlemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hoş, sıradan veya korkutucu olabilen her tür uyku düşünü kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Uyuyanın üstüne çöken, baskı ve korku veren belirli bir uyku yaşantısını anlatması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal uyku sırasında yaşanan görüntü veya duyumlarla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uyku düşlerinin genel adıdır; komşu dal yalnızca baskı, hareketsizlik ve korkuyla belirlenen özel bir uyku olayını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; geniş düş alanı, düş yorumlama ve karabasan sınırları seçildi, uyku ve sevinçli haber gibi öteki adaylar kavramı doğrudan daraltmadı.
